children.name: to
children.description:
The address to send the notification to, depending on
the channel. For example, the email address for the email channel.

children.name: from
children.description:
The address to send the notification from, depending on
the channel. For example, the email address for the email channel.

children.name: channel
children.description: The channel to send the notification through. For example, `email`.

children.name: template
children.description:
The ID of the template to use for the notification. This template ID may be defined
in a third-party service used to send the notification.

children.name: content
children.description: The content that gets passed over to the provider.

children.name: subject
children.description: the subject of the notification

children.name: text
children.description: the text content of the notification

children.name: html
children.description: the html content of the notification

children.name: data
children.description:
The data to use in the notification template. This data may be used to personalize
the notification, such as the user's name or the order number.

children.name: provider_data
children.description: Additional data specific to the provider or channel. For example, cc and bcc for emails.

children.name: trigger_type
children.description: The type of trigger that caused the notification to be sent. For example, `order_created`.

children.name: resource_id
children.description:
The ID of the resource that triggered the notification. For example, the ID of the order
that triggered the notification.

children.name: resource_type
children.description: The type of the resource that triggered the notification. For example, `order`.

children.name: receiver_id
children.description: The ID of the user receiving the notification.

children.name: original_notification_id
children.description: The ID of the original notification if it's being resent.

children.name: idempotency_key
children.description:
A key to ensure that the notification is sent only once. If the notification
is sent multiple times, the key ensures that the notification is sent only once.

children.name: attachments
children.description: Optional attachments for the notification.

children.name: content
children.description: The content of the attachment, encoded as a binary string.

children.name: filename
children.description: The filename of the attachment.

children.name: content_type
children.description: The MIME type of the attachment.

children.name: disposition
children.description: The disposition of the attachment, For example, "inline" or "attachment".

children.name: id
children.description: The ID, if the attachment is meant to be referenced within the body of the message.
